title: Verification scripts for: Two-basepoint Terwilliger algebras and the quantum rigidity of circulant graphs of prime order
description:
Exact-arithmetic verification of every computational claim in the paper Two-basepoint Terwilliger algebras and the quantum rigidity of circulant graphs of prime order.

Part A checks the four capture certificates of Section 6 (p = 13, 17, 31, 41). Part B checks the confinement lemma, the quadratic threshold p > (k-1)^2 + 2, the enumeration of the eight residual pairs in types at most 10, and their singleton-block witnesses. Part C reruns the saturation of Theorem 7.1 for all 214 pairs (p, E) with p ≤ 250, over the rationals for small p and over F_q with q = 1000003 throughout. Part D checks the capture-depth table of Appendix A. No floating-point arithmetic is used anywhere.
